title: Discovery Record
description: A machine-readable Architecture Discovery — a question put to the Virtual Architect Agent, which interrogates the architecture state and produces a point-in-time view in answer. Stored at architectures/clients/<client>/<version>/discovery/<id>/discovery.json. SCAFFOLD: the discovery workflow is not yet implemented.

discovery-id.description: Unique identifier in the form DSC-NNN (three-digit number, uppercase). Must match the parent folder name.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the discovery.

status.description: Active discoveries are live; archived discoveries are retained for reference.

context.description: The situation or background framing the discovery — what the architecture currently looks like and why the question is being asked.

request.description: The question or analysis requested of the Virtual Architect Agent.

findings.description: The point-in-time view produced by the Virtual Architect Agent. Populated by the discovery workflow (not yet implemented).

who.description: Display name of the person or agent.
